title: Glowing sailing boat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
      <!-- sky glow stars -->
      <circle cx='14' cy='14' r='1.6' fill='#8fd3ff'/>
      <circle cx='30' cy='8' r='1.1' fill='#b7e4ff'/>
      <circle cx='84' cy='12' r='1.4' fill='#8fd3ff'/>
      <circle cx='70' cy='20' r='1' fill='#b7e4ff'/>
      <circle cx='46' cy='16' r='1' fill='#9fe0ff'/>
      <!-- moon -->
      <circle cx='80' cy='26' r='7' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
      <circle cx='77' cy='24' r='1.6' fill='#f6d27a'/>
      <circle cx='83' cy='29' r='1.2' fill='#f6d27a'/>

      <!-- sea -->
      <rect x='0' y='72' width='100' height='28' fill='#1b3a6b'/>
      <path d='M0 72 q12 -4 25 0 q13 4 26 0 q12 -4 24 0 q13 4 25 0 v6 H0 Z' fill='#2b5fa3'/>
      <path d='M6 84 q8 -3 16 0 q8 3 16 0 q8 -3 16 0 q8 3 16 0 q8 -3 16 0' fill='none' stroke='#57a8e8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
      <path d='M14 92 q8 -3 16 0 q8 3 16 0 q8 -3 16 0 q8 3 16 0' fill='none' stroke='#3f86c9' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

      <!-- hull -->
      <path d='M22 70 L78 70 L68 82 L32 82 Z' fill='#c9822f'/>
      <path d='M22 70 L78 70 L75 74 L25 74 Z' fill='#efb45c'/>
      <path d='M32 82 L68 82 L65 78 L35 78 Z' fill='#a8631f'/>

      <!-- mast -->
      <rect x='48' y='26' width='3' height='44' fill='#e8ddc0'/>
      <rect x='48' y='26' width='1.2' height='44' fill='#fff4d6'/>

      <!-- main sail -->
      <path d='M52 28 L52 66 L76 66 Z' fill='#fff1cf'/>
      <path d='M52 28 L52 66 L62 66 Z' fill='#ffd98a'/>

      <!-- jib sail -->
      <path d='M47 30 L47 66 L26 66 Z' fill='#ffb3d1'/>
      <path d='M47 30 L47 66 L36 66 Z' fill='#e882b0'/>

      <!-- pennant -->
      <path d='M51 25 L64 29 L51 33 Z' fill='#ff5f6d'/>

      <!-- hull lantern glow -->
      <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='3.2' fill='#fff3b0'/>
      <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='5.6' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.35'/>

      <!-- reflection -->
      <path d='M24 86 q13 -4 26 0 q13 4 26 0' fill='none' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
      <path d='M38 92 q12 -3 24 0' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3d1' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    </svg>
